summary: Ericsson filed a Form 6-K announcing weekly share repurchases (June 29–July 3, 2026) under a previously disclosed buyback program of up to SEK 15 billion running through March 2027. During the reported week, it repurchased 3.1 million Class B shares at a weighted average price of ~SEK 106.87, for a total transaction value of ~SEK 331 million. The Board intends to propose cancellation of repurchased shares at the 2027 AGM. Acquisitions are executed by Goldman Sachs Bank Europe SE on Nasdaq Stockholm under the EU Safe Harbour Regulation. Following the buybacks, treasury stock holds ~67.1 million Class B shares out of ~3.37 billion total shares. This is a routine periodic disclosure of an ongoing capital return program, not a new special-situation event.
